title: A Trial of Vitamins and HAART in HIV Disease Progression
brief_summary: This study is a double-blind randomized clinical trial, conducted to examine the effects of multivitamins (including B, C, and E) on HIV disease progression among HIV-positive Tanzanian adult men and women taking highly active anti-retroviral therapy (HAART).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* HIV-positive
* Men or Women
* 18 Years of Age or older
* Initiating HAART at time of randomization

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or Lactating Women
* Individuals at pre-HAART disease stages
* BMI less than 16
